He wants that whole street on fire.|Moros, to Lear|}} '''Moros''' was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[swamp trooper]]. By around [[18 BBY]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=Andor's Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}} Moros had the rank of [[Private]] and participated in a [[Unidentified massacre (Luthen Rael)|massacre]] of the population of a [[Unidentified planet (Luthen Rael)|planet]]. During the fighting, he attempted to locate [[Sergeant]] [[Luthen Rael|Lear]] on behalf of [[Captain]] [[Amari]] and found him in their [[starship]]. Moros asked their fellow [[Imperial Army trooper|trooper]] for any "[[Flamethrower|burners]]," and let him know his radio was off, promptly turning it back on. Moros was a human with [[Color|pale]] skin and brown hair. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Moros appeared in a flashback sequence of "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]. [[Jacob Avery]] portrayed the character, whose name was revealed in the final credits for the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=モロス |ka=მოროსი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army troopers]]
